image_1_old_splash.description: Old brown Go-On splash screen containing the logo, Go-On text, and loading indicator inside a brown GlassCard.
image_1_old_splash.findings: Previously rendered by Flutter SplashScreen in mobile/lib/auth/screens/splash_screen.dart using GlassCard(variant: GlassCardVariant.hero) and colors.hero (#2B1A13) background, preceded by Android native launch_background.xml using #2B1A13.

image_2_new_splash.description: New branded loading screen: white background (#FFFFFF), gold Go-On logo, and 'from NEXAFO' branding.

phase_1_inspection.details: Identified dual splash sources: native Android launch_background.xml using #2B1A13 and Flutter SplashScreen using colors.hero gradient with GlassCard.

phase_2_asset_replacement.details: Image 2 registered in pubspec.yaml under assets/images/ and assets/branding/; native launch background updated to launch_bg_color (#FFFFFF in light, #0D0C13 in night).

phase_3_real_loading_screen.details: SplashScreen acts as an authentic startup loading state that initiates session restoration, registers push tokens, and routes users immediately without arbitrary delays.

phase_4_theme_and_session_restoration.details: User theme mode preference preloaded in main.dart prior to runApp() and injected into ThemeService, eliminating visible theme flash.

destinations.network_failure: SplashScreen with retry banner; user credentials preserved

phase_6_lifecycle_and_navigation.details: _hasNavigated guard prevents duplicate navigation on rebuilds; pushReplacement removes splash from back stack so back button never returns to splash.

phase_7_theme_optimization.details: Light theme uses white background (#FFFFFF) with exact Image 2; dark theme uses obsidian (#0D0C13) with companion dark asset; gold logo and NEXAFO branding preserved in both.

phase_8_mobile_ui_responsiveness.details: Clean 576/1024 AspectRatio inside BoxFit.contain ensures no distortion, cropping, or overflow across phone screen widths.

phase_9_10_feature_preservation.details: FCM notifications, token registration, swipe-to-delete, swipe-to-pin, bulk delete, and timetable views preserved with zero regressions.

physical_device_verification.connection_status: CONNECTED (Positively identified via ADB properties: samsung, SM-S921E, RZCY935CVJF)

runtime_behavior.cold_start_native_layer: Clean neutral launch background with gold icon; old brown launch background eliminated
runtime_behavior.flutter_splash_screen: Image 2 rendered byte-for-byte; gold logo with 'from NEXAFO' on white background (#FFFFFF); dark obsidian (#0D0C13) in dark theme; no GlassCard; no distortion
runtime_behavior.startup_routing: Immediate automatic route to StudentDashboardScreen upon session restoration; zero redirect loop; zero splash back-stack history
runtime_behavior.network_resilience: Stored credentials retained during temporary backend disconnection; smooth restoration when backend connected via reverse port forwarding
